create_openai_gpt_config: create an OpenAIGPTConfig with vocabulary size, embedding dimension, and number of transformer layers
build_openai_gpt_model: build an OpenAIGPTModel transformer with token and position embeddings and stacked attention blocks
run_language_modeling: run OpenAIGPTLMHeadModel forward pass to compute language modeling loss and prediction scores
run_multiple_choice_classification: run OpenAIGPTDoubleHeadsModel forward pass to compute multiple choice classification and language modeling outputs
load_tf_weights_in_openai_gpt: load TensorFlow pre-trained weights from NumPy arrays into a PyTorch OpenAI GPT model
